source_reuse.restoration: Download canonical pinned URL; verify raw SHA-256 above. Existing lawful retained gzip source and metadata live in merged PR #584 at the path above; this packet references those exact bytes to avoid duplicating a 74.8 MB file.

findings.source_identity: Every assigned Atlas original_id matches exactly one of the 1,122 retained geoBoundaries DANE-declared 2020 ADM2 shape IDs. Exact display names are compared row by row; joins use IDs and parent chains, never names alone. This establishes source identity only, not current official validity or semantic tier suitability.
findings.area_partition: This packet owns 190/1,122 Colombia locations only. Area review must reconcile with the other Colombia packets; no shared area or region conclusion is made.
findings.province_purpose: Seven issue-listed department cohorts are complete: Cauca, Putumayo, Valle del Cauca, Risaralda, Córdoba, Quindío and Huila. Every assigned child chain is recorded. Role, parent footprint, settlements, complete descendants and purpose still need current authoritative evidence.
findings.administrative_remainders: No exhaustive official listing of unassigned/anonymous remainder units has been crosswalked; source exact-count and current structure do not prove their absence.
findings.islands_and_disconnected_territories: Component and ring counts are recorded by assigned source/current polygon, but disconnected components and island identities are not adjudicated.
findings.physical_land_screen: GSHHG 2.3.7 full-resolution 2017 physical coastline screen: all 190 Atlas source representative points lie in level-1 land polygons; four assigned current polygons contain a candidate level-1 ring centroid. This global physical source is not an administrative or settlement authority; screen cannot establish whole-boundary agreement, every island, connected territory, or hydrography.
findings.neighbor_consistency: Exact consecutive-coordinate segment screen compares all 1,122 source ADM2 polygons with all current Atlas polygons. One internal assigned source adjacency is absent from the current exact-segment graph: San Miguel (La Dorada), Putumayo and Puerto Asís, Putumayo. This is a coordinated review lead only; vertex splitting, precision differences and actual geometry discrepancy are unresolved. No shared geometry changed.
findings.gaps: DANE DIVIPOLA MGN 2024 and Centros Poblados 2013I item metadata and access limitations are documented in #492 source registry; their feature rows and licenses were not accessible there. A bounded issue #583 restores those rows only for batch 3, so this batch needs an exact 190-ID DANE/settlement restoration child if service access remains unavailable.
